subject.title: feat: carry Featured state into Control

question: How should authoritative Featured semantics be activated without clearing curation when Control reads the current legacy production feed?
rationale: The safe answer depends on the intended cross-repository producer contract and deployment order; an optional entry field alone cannot distinguish a legacy omission from an intentional unfeature.

options.title: Add a capability gate
options.body: Add a feed-level capability or schema revision and make omission authoritative only after the producer explicitly advertises support.

options.title: Coordinate producer-first rollout
options.body: Deploy the producer with complete Featured values before merging the consumer and provide proof that no legacy feed can reach the new authority path.

recommendation.title: Add a capability gate
recommendation.body: Add a feed-level capability or schema revision and make omission authoritative only after the producer explicitly advertises support.

likelyOwner.reason: This person is most closely associated with the shipped hosted catalog and fallback contract that needs the rollout decision.
